interface.name: gnoblin_blur_fade_manager_v1

description.summary: commit animation opacity separately from glass transparency

interface.description: A client that fades items inside a top-level surface can describe their animation opacity separately from the alpha of its glass material. This metadata is double buffered and applies with wl_surface.commit. It does not enable blur or change foreground pixels. Window rules remain responsible for enabling blur. Without metadata, the compositor treats buffer alpha as material transparency.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Existing surface state remains valid until replaced or the surface is destroyed.

request.name: set_fades
request.description: The array contains up to 32 records of five signed 24.8 fixed point values: x, y, width, height and opacity. Coordinates are in top-level surface logical coordinates. Width and height must be nonnegative and opacity must be in [0,1]. Each record describes an independently faded item, including its inherited opacity. Records must not describe both an ancestor and its child. Overlapping items contribute the union of their animation coverage. Buffer alpha supplies the visible silhouette. Pixels outside the records retain normal material transparency. An empty array removes all metadata on the next surface commit. Send the metadata before the commit of the corresponding rendered frame. Each item's opacity must multiply its completed texture once, rather than being applied separately to overlapping children inside the item.
